text:
Alex K: Quick sync request  we need a compact cross-team contract for error metrics + one reliability dashboard covering timeouts / 5xx / oom / degraded/fallback counts. Aim: PMs, SREs, and Console can detect regressions and correlate with rollouts. Can infra/runtime owners propose metric names, labels, and source by EOD Tue?

Maria S: Runtime proposal:
- Counter: request_outcome_total{model_family, route, outcome, error_code?} with outcome in [success, timeout, fallback, oom, 5xx]. Keep error_code optional and only for 5xx/oom.
- Latency: request_duration_seconds_bucket{model_family, route, outcome} for SLO buckets.
- Fallbacks: fallback_count_total{model_family, route, fallback_reason} where fallback_reason limited to [kv_miss, capacity, policy].

Sample PromQL (runtime):
```
# overall non-success rate by model_family
(sum by(model_family) (increase(request_outcome_total{outcome!="success"}[5m]))) /
(sum by(model_family) (increase(request_outcome_total[5m])))

# OOMs last hour
increase(request_outcome_total{outcome="oom"}[1h])

# Top routes by fallback rate
topk(10, (increase(request_outcome_total{outcome="fallback"}[15m])) / (increase(request_outcome_total[15m])))
```

Dinesh P: Infra notes:
- K8s OOMKilled != runtime OOM. Infra will export container_oom_events_total{node, deployment}.
- Ingress 5xx split: ingress_5xx_total{proxy=envoy|nginx, route}.
- Dedupe rule: prefer runtime 5xx for request-level diagnostics; keep ingress 5xx for network/failure visibility.
- Cardinality rule: avoid high-cardinality labels (no model_version on hot counters).

Derived infra query suggestion:
```
# combined error signal: use runtime when present, fallback to ingress
(sum by(route) (increase(runtime_request_errors_total[5m])))
+
(sum by(route) (increase(ingress_5xx_total[5m]) unless runtime_request_errors_total))
```

Emily R: Console / Product asks:
- Top KPI row: error rate (5m / 1h), OOM count (24h), fallback rate (15m), median latency p50/p95.
- Breakdown panel: stacked by outcome (timeout/5xx/oom/fallback).
- Route heatmap: top 50 routes x time buckets showing error rate.
- Rollouts: need annotation stream (canary start/end) to overlay on graphs.
- UX: each panel should have "jump to logs" and "open runbook" CTAs.

Jules: Console can host an annotation endpoint that accepts {deployment, tag, start_ts, end_ts, stage}. We'll write to Grafana annotation store. Need schema and auth.

SRE Bot: Created alert rule: HighCombinedErrorRate -> fires when combined error rate >2% over 5m for critical routes. Alert link: https://grafana.internal/alerts/1234 :rotating_light:

Alex K: Contract proposal summary for ownership and names:
- Runtime (owner: Maria S): request_outcome_total, request_duration_seconds_bucket.
- Infra (owner: Dinesh P): ingress_5xx_total, container_oom_events_total.
- Console annotations (owner: Jules): rollout_event{deployment, tag, start_ts, end_ts, stage}.
- Dashboard & alerts (owner: Alex K).

Open questions:
- Retries: should retries be separate outcomes (retry_success/retry_failure) or folded?
- Should runtime include a sampled label for model_version on a low-rate path or logs only?

Maria S: I prefer folding retries for high-level KPIs. We'll emit retry_attempts_total{result} as a low-volume debug counter. We'll avoid model_version on hot counters; runtime will write model_version to trace/span or sampled logs.

Dinesh P: Agree on fold for KPI. Infra will add container_oom_events_total and ingress_5xx_total this week. We will also add a label `proxy` on ingress 5xx so Console can filter gateway vs runtime-originated errors.

Alex K: Action items and deadlines:
- Maria to open runtime PR adding request_outcome_total + buckets by Tue EOD (owner: Maria S).
- Dinesh to add ingress_5xx_total + container_oom_events_total by Tue EOD (owner: Dinesh P).
- Jules to document rollout_event schema and auth by Tue.
- Alex to draft dashboard JSON and alert rules; PR targeted Wed.

Maria S: One more small ask  include outcome="partial_success"? Some multimodal ops return partial results and are semantically not success. If Console wants to split, we can add it to the enum.

Emily R: Yes add partial_success to outcome enum please. Console will treat partial_success as non-success for error KPIs but display it separately in breakdown.

SRE Bot: Reminder: after metrics land, run a backfill check to ensure no label explosions. Use the linter: https://infra.internal/metrics-lint :white_check_mark:

Alex K: Nice. If folks can push the metric PRs by Tue EOD we'll merge dashboard + alerts Wed. Thanks all.
